# V5-29 bracket reuse fixture

This fixture is synthetic software evidence. It uses a four-bolt rectangular
support, an explicitly identified elementary load case, and a fixture-only
material allowable. The quantities are N, N m, mm, MPa, kg/m³ and g as printed
by the pack data card. No oil, flow, hydrocyclone geometry, as-built material,
manufacturing record, validated FEA, fatigue, or service data exists here.

`campaigns/bracket-v5-fixture.toml` is the bounded three-attempt campaign.
`input.json` freezes the domain inputs. The pack test generates the result and
the SVG data card offline from these exact values. A structural fixture screen
is not manufacturing, service, or physical qualification.
